subject: Recap + proposed MPA & timeline — Redwood pilot for Novara Health
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@novarahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Recap + proposed MPA & timeline — Redwood pilot for Novara Health

Hi Marta — thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and a suggested Mutual Action Plan (MPA) so we have a single view of milestones, owners, and dates. Please flag anything I missed or any changes to owners/dates.

Key pain points you reiterated
- High latency on in-house LLM endpoints for clinical triage (95th perc latency spikes during morning batches)
- Cost unpredictability as usage grows (token spend and GPU hours)
- Need for privacy controls (PHI handling, VPC routing, audit logs)

Primary goals for the 6-week pilot
1) Reduce 95th percentile latency to <= 500ms for typical triage flows
2) Stabilize per-session cost projections using batching and caching profiles
3) Validate secure access model (private VPC + KMS) and basic audit traces

Proposed MPA (high level) — draft attached (Novara_MPA_Draft_v1.pdf)
- Week 0 (Kickoff): project kickoff + access + test data schema (Owner: Marta) — target week of Mar 29
- Week 1–2 (Integration): data ingestion + model routing + baseline perf (Owner: Jasmine) — target Apr 5–16
- Week 3–4 (Optimization): batching, quantization recommendations, cost modeling (Owner: Ben) — target Apr 19–30
- Week 5 (Validation): run acceptance prompts, security checklist, exec review (Owner: Soojin) — target May 3
- Week 6 (Decision): go/no-go + procurement sign-off (Owner: Novara procurement) — target May 10

Decision makers we heard on the call (please confirm):
- Marta Ruiz — Head of Data (primary sponsor)
- Samir Patel — CTO (technical sign-off)
- Leah Kim — Procurement (commercial sign-off)

Immediate asks / next steps
- Can you confirm the procurement contact (name + email) we should include?
- Can you confirm the acceptance criteria for latency and cost (is target above aligned?)
- We’ve attached a first-pass MPA and a short checklist for PHI handling — happy to update based on your feedback.

Attachments: Novara_MPA_Draft_v1.pdf (MPA draft), Redwood_trial_scope.csv (schema sample)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-novara-mpa
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7391

If everything looks reasonable, we can 1) lock dates and 2) send a DocuSign SOW + security package.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0118

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@novarahealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@novarahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed MPA & timeline — Redwood pilot for Novara Health

Thanks Jasmine — this is a helpful summary and the targets look reasonable. A few notes: 

- Procurement contact is Leah Kim (leah.kim@novarahealth.com) — copying Samir to confirm.
- We will need a short SOC 2 summary and evidence we can share internally (audit checklist + data flow diagram). Can you attach that to the SOW?
- The latency target is OK as a working goal; can you also include an SLA/rollback plan if latency targets are not met after optimization?

On blockers: our security team will want to validate the VPC/KMS flow and confirm we can keep PHI in our VPC.

If you can update the MPA with Leah as procurement owner and add a SOC 2 summary, I’ll schedule the internal kickoff for week of Mar 29.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Novara pilot — pricing band question

Jasmine / Soojin — quick internal note.
- Novara looks like a mid-sized HS account; typical commercial path is a 6-week pilot (paid, refundable against contract) + procurement review.
- We should consider offering a 20% pilot credit to accelerate procurement sign-off; it helps reduce friction for procurement teams that need financial runway.
- I can model the pilot cost with/without the credit. Would you like me to add the discounted numbers into the MPA doc and push the updated doc to Leah?

Also, include SOC2_summary.pdf when we send the SOW packet.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@novarahealth.com>, Leah Kim <leah.kim@novarahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@novarahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 14:45:00 -0400
Subject: Finalized MPA v1.1 + SOC2 summary — ready for kickoff week of Mar 29

Hi Marta / Leah / Samir — following up with the updated MPA and SOC2 summary we discussed. Ben added a pilot pricing scenario with a 20% pilot credit (see section 4). Per Marta's ask, I included an SLA rollback clause (section 6) and a short security checklist for VPC + KMS validation.

High-level milestones (finalized)
- Kickoff & access provisioning — target Mar 30 (Owner: Novara - Marta)
- Integration & baseline collection — target Apr 6 (Owner: Jasmine)
- Optimization & cost modeling — target Apr 20 (Owner: Ben)
- Validation & security sign-off — target May 3 (Owner: Soojin / Novara security)
- Exec review & procurement sign-off — target May 10 (Owner: Leah / Samir)
- Decision (go/no-go) — May 12 (expected)

Acceptance criteria (short)
- 95th perc latency <= 500ms on our sample triage set (baseline to be captured during integration)
- Cost per session projection within agreed band (see attached table in MPA v1.1)
- Security checklist items validated: VPC peering, KMS key usage, audit log access

Attachments included: Novara_MPA_v1.1.pdf (MPA with pricing scenarios), SOC2_summary.pdf (security evidence packet)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7391
DocuSign SOW (will send once procurement confirms): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/novara-mpa-docusign
Drive (working folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-novara-mpa

Next steps
1) Leah — can you confirm procurement availability for the week of Apr 5–9 so we can align contract cadence?
2) Marta / Samir — confirm acceptance criteria above or suggest edits by EOD Mar 26.
3) Ben / Soojin — I’ll ask you both to join the kickoff (30 mins) to review integration scope.

Thanks all — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0118

Attachments: Novara_MPA_v1.1.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf
